title: [Interview] ‘Georgia has reached final stage of autocratic consolidation,’ warns former deputy foreign minister
lede: Georgia’s fall from EU frontrunner to near-total state capture is not just a regional tragedy but a case study in how Russia exploits European complacency to pull an entire country back into its orbit, explains former minister.

title: More EU sanctions on Russian propagandists and hackers, as thousands of fake accounts target voters
lede: The EU agreed on Monday (16 November) to sanction 30 people and two organisations over Russian cyberattacks and disinformation campaigns targeting Europe, as researchers uncovered thousands of fake accounts used to target election campaigns.
